description: 西西里飞龙 B78 — 异侧易位攻防节奏

intro.popup:
练习第9局
西西里飞龙
经典异侧易位！
黑方O-O短易位（王翼）
白方O-O-O长易位（后翼）
h4冲兵！谁先到谁赢
这是国际象棋最激烈的开局之一！
intro.popup_en:
Practice Game 9
Sicilian Dragon
A classic opposite-side castling race: Black castles kingside, while White castles queenside. White pushes h4 toward Black's king. In one of chess's sharpest opening battles, the first attack to break through can decide the game.

outro.popup:
异侧易位的攻防节奏
飞龙体系核心：
① 黑方g6+Bg7建立飞龙象
② 白方长易位后向h4冲兵
③ 黑方向b4/a5推进反攻
④ 双方几乎不考虑防御！
节奏：谁先完成攻击准备，谁就赢！
outro.popup_en: Opposite-side castling in the Dragon: Black's ...g6 and ...Bg7 establish the fianchettoed bishop; White castles long and advances the h-pawn; Black counterattacks with queenside pushes such as ...b4 or ...a5. Both sides focus on attack, and the race favors whoever is ready to break through first.

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and occupies the center.
...c5 begins the Sicilian Defense.
Nf3 develops and prepares to challenge the center.
...Nc6 develops and supports central control.
d4 challenges Black's central pawn.
...cxd4 captures on d4.
Nxd4 recaptures and centralizes the knight.
...g6 signals the Dragon setup and prepares to fianchetto the bishop on g7.
Nc3 develops and reinforces the center.

moves.popup:
Bg7飞龙象就位
这头龙是黑方的主要武器
moves.popup_en: ...Bg7 completes the Dragon bishop's fianchetto. This bishop is one of Black's key attacking pieces.
Be3 develops and supports White's central setup.
...Nf6 develops and pressures e4.
f3 reinforces the center and prevents ...Ne4.

moves.popup:
O-O黑方短易位！
王去g8，受到飞龙象和各子保护
王翼阵型完整
moves.popup_en: ...O-O! Black castles kingside. The king on g8 is supported by the fianchettoed bishop and the other pieces, completing a secure kingside setup.

moves.popup:
Qd2！白方准备长易位
这是飞龙体系标准做法
moves.popup_en: Qd2! White prepares to castle queenside, a standard plan against the Dragon.
...d6 reinforces Black's center.

moves.popup:
O-O-O！白方长易位！
双方王现在在对面：
黑王g8 vs 白王c1
异侧易位正式开始！
双方都要向对方王翼冲兵！
moves.popup_en: O-O-O! White castles long. The kings now stand on opposite wings: Black's king on g8 and White's on c1. The race is on, with each side ready to advance pawns toward the opposing king.
Nxd4 exchanges the knight on d4.
Bxd4 recaptures the knight.
...Be6 develops the bishop and supports Black's position.

moves.popup:
Kb1！王步微调
王去b1，远离c列
避免将来c列打开后王受攻击
moves.popup_en: Kb1! White sidesteps the c-file, moving the king away from danger if that file opens later.
...Qc7 centralizes the queen and prepares Black's attack.

moves.popup:
h4！白方h兵冲进！
直指g7飞龙象和黑王阵地
飞龙体系最关键的进攻手段
节奏决定一切——谁先突破谁赢！
moves.popup_en: h4! White launches the h-pawn toward the Dragon bishop on g7 and Black's king. This is a key attacking method in the Dragon, where timing and the race to break through are critical.
